fields.reasoning: The question records run 01M77DW ending with green PR #480 unmerged because land was refused on change set 01M763Z4's stale-base update to ship-check-ci-test-findings, and land-triage (rhiza ship gate --failed) only passes for a recorded pre-push failure, so any other land failure ends the run. The model already supports the repair: buildUpdate in internal/api/write_node.go has --rebase, which moves a pending update onto the landed version only when the call restates every field it writes, so landed work is not silently replaced. ship-change already pairs every other refusal class with a triage step and a bounded fixer (rebase-triage -> conflict-fix for code conflicts, gate-fix for gates, ci-fix for CI), so a model conflict should follow the same shape rather than strand a merge-ready PR for the watchdog. Making the gate fail on the shipping change set's own conflicts closes the gap the question names: rhiza check only warns for in-flight conflicts, so every check passed and the problem surfaced only at land. Restricting the hard failure to the shipping change set keeps other in-flight change sets' conflicts from blocking unrelated runs.
fields.statement: ship-change treats a land refused on a model conflict (the shipping change set's own operation resting on a stale base) as a fixable step, not an end. ship land reports the refusal distinctly (the conflicting nodes and fields, both versions) and land-triage routes it to a model-conflict fixer agent; the fixer restates each conflicting update on the landed version with `rhiza set <ref> --rebase`, keeping the landed change's work and adding this change set's intent, commits the rewritten .rhiza/log entry with the Change/Actor/Review trailers, and the run goes back through the gate and land (bounded by max_visits, so a repeat conflict still fails the run with the conflict named). Earlier, the pre-land gate (and rhiza ship check) fails, rather than only warns, on a conflict in the shipping change set's own operations, so the stale base is repaired before sign-off where possible. Conflicts of other in-flight change sets stay warnings.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... passes with a test that the builtin ship-change routes land's fail through land-triage to the model-conflict triage, its pass to the fixer agent and the fixer back to render, gate-land and land, with land allowed the extra visits and the loop bounded; go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/run-ship-model-conflict-fix passes with a new testscript run-ship-model-conflict-fix.txtar (beside run-ship-conflict-fix.txtar) in which land is refused on the shipping change set's stale-base update, the fixer rebases it with `rhiza set <ref> --rebase`, and the run passes back through gate-land and land to a merged PR; make self-check passes
